title: Mango Sticky Rice
description: Soaked and steamed glutinous rice soaked in sweet, salty coconut milk, served with ripe mango and a drizzle of coconut sauce.
equipment: Steamer basket lined with cheesecloth, or a microwave-safe bowl

image.alt: Sticky rice with sliced ripe mango and coconut sauce

steps.text: Rinse the rice until the water runs clear, then cover with water and soak for at least {time 4 hr notimer}, or overnight. Drain.
Steam the rice in the lined steamer over boiling water until tender and translucent, {time 20-25 min}.

Meanwhile warm three-quarters of the coconut milk with most of the sugar and half the salt until dissolved; don’t boil. Stir the hot rice into it, cover and let it soak up the coconut milk for {time 20 min}.
Simmer the rest of the coconut milk with the remaining sugar and salt and the cornstarch mixed with a splash of water until slightly thickened, {time 2 min}.
Serve the rice with mango slices, drizzled with the coconut sauce and sprinkled with sesame seeds.

notes: Glutinous rice contains no gluten; the name refers to its sticky texture.
Best eaten the day it’s made, while the rice is soft.
